update.title: execute_command
update.rawInput:
{"command":"python - <<'EOF'
import hashlib, os

exclude_dirs = {"__pycache__"}
out = []
files = []
for root, dirs, names in os.walk("."):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in exclude_dirs]
    for n in names:
        p = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(root, n))
        if p in ("SOURCE_FREEZE.txt",) or p.startswith("dist/") or p.startswith("build/"):
            continue
        files.append(p)

files.sort()
for p in files:
    data = open(p, "rb").read()
    h = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    out.append(f"{h}  {os.path.getsize(p):>8}  {p}")

with open("SOURCE_FREEZE.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write("# SOURCE_FREEZE.txt — trustdemo source inputs\n")
    f.write("# SHA-256  size(bytes)  path\n")
    f.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")

print("\n".join(out))
EOF"}

update.title: execute_command
update.rawInput:
{"command":"python - <<'EOF'
# Independent verification: recompute all hashes and sizes, compare against SOURCE_FREEZE.txt
import hashlib, os, re

lines = [l for l in open("SOURCE_FREEZE.txt") if l.strip() and not l.startswith("#")]
assert len(lines) == 2, f"expected 2 entries, got {len(lines)}"
for l in lines:
    h, size, path = l.split()
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == h, f"hash mismatch: {path}"
    assert os.path.getsize(path) == int(size), f"size mismatch: {path}"
    print("OK", path)
print("SOURCE_FREEZE.txt verified")
EOF"}
